text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf might have forfeited<n>the Triple
Crown, but she can still win<n>something just as
valuable: the<n>shield of the spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Her spirits are high as she looks to<n>her next race,
but they turn to concern<n>when she sees Air Groove,
who<n>seems exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Realizing that she is the reason Air<n>Groove has
been running herself<n>ragged, Symboli Rudolf
resolves not<n>to skimp on her presidential duties.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As the year comes to an end, it<n>seems that the
pair's desire to<n>lighten one another's burdens is
preventing them from seeing eye to<n>eye.
